apple.name: RailCommand
apple.subtitle: Offline rail field logs
apple.promotionalText: Capture daily field logs, photos, and optional location even when connectivity drops, then synchronize safely when service returns.
apple.description:
RailCommand gives authorized rail and construction teams a focused mobile workflow for daily field reporting.

Use your organization-issued RailCommand account to select a project, review cached project and team information, create a daily log, attach field photos and optional location, and monitor synchronization status.

Scoped offline support protects new daily-log drafts and photos when connectivity drops. Reconnect to synchronize each queued item safely. Existing records remain read-only offline, and administrative modules remain available in the connected web application.

RailCommand is licensed directly to organizations. The mobile app contains no ads, in-app purchases, or public account registration.
apple.whatsNew: Initial RailCommand mobile release with organization sign-in, project selection, cached field references, offline daily-log drafts, photo and optional location capture, durable synchronization, Sync Center, notifications, privacy controls, and account-deletion initiation.
